How this works

Five things, and you know the whole CRM.

Leads live in your database

Import a CSV, add one by hand, or let the scraper send them in. Everything saves as you do it. Settings, Data downloads a backup any time.

Local businesses: call, email, follow up

Power dial works the list one lead at a time with the script on screen; calls ring out through your own phone. Emails send themselves once a day. Replies land on the lead and float to the top.

Online coaches: Instagram, then the stage

Open the profile from the card, send the DM, come back and move them along: Not DM'd, DM'd, Answered, Interested, Left on read, Loom sent, Call booked, Closed. The DM run does it in order with the follow-up scripts on screen.

This week keeps you honest

Reports, This week: what went out, what came back and what it made, against last week, with the people waiting on you. Email it to yourself, or have it arrive on a schedule from Settings, Sending.

The board is your pipeline

Drag a lead between columns as it progresses; on a phone, open the lead and change its status. Working as a team? Assign leads from the drawer and filter the list to yours.

Ask the assistant

The bubble at the bottom right answers from your CRM: who replied, who is waiting, what you collected. It runs on a free key you keep in Settings, Assistant.

Call from this computer (one-time setup)
  • Mac + iPhone: open the Mac's Phone app (older Macs: FaceTime settings) and finish its setup, and on the iPhone allow Settings, Phone, Calls on Other Devices.
  • Windows + Android: install Microsoft's free Phone Link app and pair your phone once.
  • Windows + iPhone: Phone Link pairs over Bluetooth for basic calling.

Calls go out on your own number and cost nothing extra. No computer around? Open this page on your phone and tap Call instead.

One thing to connect first

This CRM keeps accounts in Supabase and it is not connected yet. In Vercel, add your project's URL and service key, redeploy, and come back here to make your account.

One thing to set first

Nobody has an account here yet, and this deployment has no setup code, so anyone who found the address could claim it. In Vercel, add an environment variable named SETUP_CODE, at least eight characters long, redeploy, then come back and type it here to make your account.

Only the people you have allowed can sign in here.
